issue.title: Project run- and node-level duration_seconds in the Rust finalizer run view instead of summing attempts in the TUI

task_type_fields.proposal:
Project run- and node-level finalizer durations in the Rust run view, so every frontend shares one aggregation.

Epic sase-1b2's plan (plan:202609/agents_tab_final_deck.md section 3.4, "Node aggregate: status, glyph key, duration, ...") named a node aggregate duration and per-run durations. sase-1b2.3 (note #1) found no defined source at the time and left the fields out. Today sase-core's finalizer::run_view wire carries duration_seconds only on RunViewAttemptWire and RunViewOperationWire; RunViewRunWire and FinalizerNodeViewWire have none. The TUI fills the gap in Python by summing attempt durations in two places: src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/decks/final/overview_card.py (_attempt_durations/_instance_durations feed the Overview header total and per-instance durations) and src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/decks/final/run_blocks.py (run_duration_seconds feeds the run-block divider). sase final status (src/sase/finalizers/cli.py) shows only attempt and op durations.

Proposed change: in sase-core, compute duration_seconds for each RunViewRun (sum of its instances' attempt durations, None when none are known) and for the node (with the D10 supersede rule deciding which runs count), plus tests. Then move sase-core-revision.txt past that commit, add the fields to the Python facade (src/sase/core/finalizer_run_view.py), and replace both Python aggregations with the projected values. sase final status can then print run and node totals that match the TUI.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Out of scope for the sase-1b2 landing because every user-visible duration the epic promised already renders: the Overview total, per-instance durations and run-block durations are shown by summing Rust-projected attempt durations. What remains is a Rust-core backend-boundary cleanup that needs a sase-core wire change, a pin move and a Python facade update across two repos, not missing behavior. Proposed by sase-1b2.3 note #1 and filed by sase-1b2.land.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1b2.3 note #1; the sase-1b2 landing confirmed the Rust run view still lacks run/node durations and the TUI duplicates the aggregation in two Python modules.
